name: EAGE (European Association of Geoscientists & Engineers)
notes: Global geoscience association (HQ Netherlands): publishes First Break magazine, the EarthDoc library, and peer-reviewed journals (Near Surface Geophysics, Petroleum Geoscience, Geophysical Prospecting, Basin Research, Geoenergy); runs the Annual Conference & Exhibition. Journals/library largely member-gated. Evidence: eage.org read 2026-10-30.
